create.name: Deborah Eden Tull
create.bio:
Deborah Eden Tull, known to students as Eden, is a Zen Buddhist teacher and writer whose practice has always been tied to the natural world. She spent seven and a half years in monastic training at a silent Zen monastery in the Sierra Nevada foothills of California and has been teaching for around twenty-five years. She founded Mindful Living Revolution, the non-profit through which she offers her work, and she facilitates The Work That Reconnects, the group practice developed by Joanna Macy for turning concern for the world into compassionate action.

Her teaching stresses relationship: how presence and deep listening can be practised with oneself, with other people and with the wider living world, an approach she calls relational mindfulness and sets out in a book of that name. Her later book, Luminous Darkness, treats uncertainty and not-knowing as a doorway in practice rather than something to escape. She leads silent and relational retreats, a weekly online drop-in meditation, a practice community and recorded courses, and for some years she taught with UCLA's Mindful Awareness Research Center. During 2026 she has paused much of her in-person teaching to deal with a serious illness.

books.title: Luminous Darkness: An Engaged Buddhist Approach to Embracing the Unknown
books.author: Deborah Eden Tull
books.description: A Buddhist look at darkness and the unknown, inviting readers to rest in uncertainty and receptivity instead of always reaching for light and answers. It combines teachings, stories and practices from her years of Zen training.

books.title: Relational Mindfulness: A Handbook for Deepening Our Connections with Ourselves, Each Other, and the Planet
books.author: Deborah Eden Tull
books.description: Nine principles for bringing meditative presence into relationships, from conversation and conflict to intimacy and community. Deep listening serves as the anchor, much as the breath does in sitting practice.

courses.title: DIY Course: Relational Mindfulness
courses.description: A self-paced course of eight recorded video modules based on her book Relational Mindfulness, covering intention, the sacred pause, mindful inquiry and honest communication.
courses.price: Generosity Rate $300.00 USD; Standard Rate $275.00 USD; Financial Hardship Rate $250.00 USD

courses.title: REMEMBERING the Already Awakened State (weekly online meditation)
courses.description: A weekly drop-in meditation class on Zoom for all levels, with Zen-based guidance focused on resting in awareness. Payment is on a sliding scale and nobody is turned away.
courses.price: Sliding Scale contribution, no one turned away due to lack of funds

courses.title: Fierce Compassion Sangha
courses.description: Her ongoing online practice community for people who want to work with her over time, which includes the weekly meditations. It focuses on sustained practice and compassionate engagement with the world.
